notes: family: rounds. Round winner is first to empty rack; winner's gain equals the sum of losers' penalties so a round's scores sum to zero. Joker on rack = 30 penalty. If the pool empties and nobody can play, player with lowest rack total wins the round; each loser's penalty is the difference from the winner's total, and the winner receives the sum. Number of rounds / target is agreed by players (not defined in sources found). Official publisher rulebook text could not be downloaded; verified via secondary sources only. Premium 2019 edition treated as same rules as classic Rummikub.
